FN-DG1SZQTH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 577
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ellis
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 577 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by approximately $63,615 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 and ending
in Fiscal Year 2030, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting the
Alabama Eye Bank, from paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the
estimated annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 and ending in Fiscal Year
2030, based on information provided by the entity, if the respective local governments
adopt an exemption from local sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill:
County Funds ($31,810)
Municipal Funds ($63,620)
Page 1
